finest_existing_member_evidence.interpretation: Even R16 remains numerically resolved from the qualified R2048_T32 Reference on every declared state/profile metric.

constraints: Use C6N2 only to establish that placement matters and existing fixed partitions are numerically resolved; do not optimize boundaries against C6N2 errors.
Derive any new boundaries from hydrological purpose regions and forcing support, not candidate residual minima.
Keep CURRENT_LAYER_FACE and the existing integrator unchanged in the first placement discriminator.
Require fresh histories for any subsequent hydrological candidate response.

next_authority.question: Can a new surface-purpose representation family be derived prospectively from the declared 0-20, 0-40 and 0-80 hydrological support scales, without fitting C6N2 residuals, before any fresh blind response test?

placement_evidence.interpretation: Placement materially changes surface/profile fidelity and the useful direction is material- and purpose-dependent; no scalar winner or material-invariant placement is admitted.

scientific_interpretation: C6N2 answers a numerical distinguishability question, not a hydrological application-acceptance question.

No reduced member of the existing frozen fixed-partition family is numerically unresolved from the qualified R2048_T32 Reference on SURFACE_20, ROOT_ZONE_40, UPPER_ZONE_80 or PROFILE_STATE for either B01 or B14.
The absence of an unresolved reduced frontier does not imply that every reduced member is hydrologically unusable. C6N1 uncertainty is a numerical resolution floor, not an application tolerance.

Placement remains an active structural axis but reverses relative to earlier groundwater-boundary work: for surface-driven fixed-bottom-flux response, distributed/upper-zone support can strongly outperform lower-zone-focused members at the same state count.
B01 demonstrates a domain-robustness constraint: R3, R4 and P4_TOP_LOWER leave the qualified domain on U03, while U4/U8 and higher-dimensional members remain executable.
B14 retains all candidates in-domain; P4 improves the declared surface/root-zone relation versus R4, while U8 strongly improves over R8 across the surface/profile metrics.

Because C6N2 used an existing frozen family only, it does not establish an optimal surface-purpose partition. A new partition family, if studied, must be derived prospectively from purpose/physics and validated on fresh histories rather than fitted to C6N2 residuals.
